messages:
maya: FYI — Customer ACME Corp opened a formal GDPR erasure request. They want: full user-data deletion for a set of users, confirmation that backups & third-party logs were purged, and a chain-of-custody style audit bundle proving deletion actions and key lifecycle events. Ticket: #SUP-2248. Can we confirm next steps and ETA?

sasha: Thanks. Do we have the exact scope from ACME (org id, user list, export of what types of data)? We need to determine controller vs processor obligations first. Also flagging possible sub-processor hits (monitoring + logging vendors).

maya: Customer sent a CSV of 7 accounts and said "delete all personal data across systems and provide evidence within 30 days". Org id 67890. They specifically asked for any retention exceptions and whether any third-party analytics retain PII. Copying legal.

jordan: Putting legal on it. High level: we can provide evidence of actions we control (our DBs, object storage, audit logs). For sub-processors we must provide a list and, where possible, confirmation from those vendors. Legal needs: (1) statement of actions taken by Redwood, (2) redacted audit exports showing timestamps + actor ids, (3) list of sub-processors contacted and their responses. We can coordinate SLA with the customer.

tom: From infra side — I can run the purge and produce the audit export. Steps (internal):
```bash
# purge user data for org 67890
redwood-admin purge --org 67890 --users-file /tmp/acme_erasure.csv --force --dry-run=false
# export relevant audit events: deletions, key-ops, backup-purge
redwood-admin audit-export --org 67890 --events deletion,key-ops,backup-purge --since 2021-01-01 --format ndjson > /tmp/acme_audit.ndjson
```
Will also snapshot S3 lifecycle logs and our backup manifest. Note: backups on long-term tape may require vendor confirmation.

ops-bot: Created escalation ticket ESC-1142 and attached runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gdpr-erasure. Please follow checklist step 3.a for coordinated communications. :white_check_mark:

sasha: Two quick asks before purge: (1) Confirm whether customer requested deletion of logs that are strictly operational (e.g., request/response logs) vs PII-containing payloads. If logs include PII we need to scrub, not just delete pointers. (2) Any billing records tied to those users? Billing retention sometimes has legal holds.
maya: I asked ACME to clarify logs vs payloads and billing acceptance. They replied: "Delete payloads and any PII in logs; billing records may remain for accounting but mark as pseudonymized if necessary." They want evidence of KMS activity too — specifically whether any HSM-backed keys that encrypted their data were rotated or destroyed.

jordan: For KMS/HSM events we can provide key-operation audit entries (creation, rotation, disable). We cannot provide HSM vendor internal logs but can confirm key statuses and attest to actions taken by Redwood. Legal suggests a signed attestation letter once infra completes steps.

tom: Running purge now in staging and will run in prod after sign-off. Expected timeline: staging run + audit export in ~45m, production purge + evidence package in ~3-4 hours (pending sub-processor replies). I'll post the exact commands and checks here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: Draft reply to ACME (please review):
"Hi — thanks, we received your erasure request for org 67890. We're initiating deletion and will provide an evidence bundle containing: (1) exported audit events showing deletion actions and key ops, (2) a list of sub-processors we contacted and their confirmations, and (3) a signed attestation from Redwood legal. Estimated delivery: 3-5 business days (some sub-processors may take longer). Will that meet your needs?"

sasha: Looks good. Suggest adding that we will pseudonymize billing records where required and include an explanation of any exceptions. Also include a pointer to their data subject's right form if they want individual-level confirmations.
jordan: Approved pending one tweak: add the statement that we act as processor under the DPA and will supply processor-activity evidence. Then legal will prepare the attestation once infra provides exports.
maya: Signing off and sending now. I attached ESC-1142 to the customer reply. Will update thread when infra posts evidence files. :rocket:
